journey.name: Ladder
journey.description: Set a climbing ladder on the Timer, run the workout into its second round and check that it works longer than the first. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: On "Set up", which a fresh install opens on, tap "Skip for now"

Tap the "Train" tab, tap "Conditioning", then tap "Timer" at the top of the presets, and verify that the Timer is shown with a "Start workout" button, a "Work" row whose name stands alone, and the "Work", "Rest" and "Rounds" values whole, none cut off
Tap the "Fewer rounds" button until the rounds read "×3"
Tap the "Work" row and verify that its sheet shows "Ladder" reading "Off" under the quick picks
Tap "More work each round" twice and verify that the ladder reads "+0:10" over "Rounds work 0:30 · 0:40 · 0:50"
Tap "Done" and verify that the row reads "Work · +10s a round" and the total reads 2:40
Verify that the workout screen shows "Get ready", then "Work" with "Round 1 of 3" and a clock from 0:30
Tap "Skip" and verify that the screen shows "Rest" with "Next: round 2 of 3 · 0:40"
Tap "Skip" and verify that the screen shows "Work" with "Round 2 of 3" and a clock from 0:40
Return to the workout if needed, tap "End", then "End workout" in the dialog
Verify that the summary says "Saved to history"
Tap "Done", open "All presets" and verify that the unsaved card reads "30s on, +10s a round · 15s off · ×3"
